{{Quote|Now, I'd like you to explain ''exactly'' how this is my fault.''"<br />"''You ''were'' the one who tripped the silent alarm.''"<br />"''Only because ''you'' were the one who tripped over your own two feet and knocked me into it.''"<br />"''Are you calling me clumsy?''"<br />"''Of course not! I'm calling you a clumsy, blaster-brained nerf-herder.|Leia Organa to Han Solo after their escape|<ref name="Uprising" />}}
A '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyemari]] was undertaken by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to steal access codes from the Nyemari to use against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The mission became a bust when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] tripped the silent alarm, alerting the palace to her and her comrade's intrusions after they had acquired the codes. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] hid while Organa stole an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. The Rebels escaped and went back to their hidden [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The [[Nyemarian]] hiding the ''Falcon'' told them they were being followed, so the Rebels pursued the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]]. The [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphid]] played a message for Skywalker from [[Rezi Soresh]], threatening a ship full of hostages if Skywalker did not travel to meet him. Then the Glymphid [[Death/Legends|died]] from some sort of delayed [[Poison/Legends|poison]] to prove Soresh's intentions. Skywalker and his companions then went to meet Soresh to save the hostages.

==The mission==
===The Palace infiltration===
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel leader]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and her companions [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] infiltrated the [[Nyemari Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] on [[Nyemari]] to steal access codes for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Nyemari Imperial Military Installation|garrison]]. The Rebels were forced to exfiltrate when Solo bumped Organa and she hit the silent alarm. Organa went off to acquire a means of escape while Skywalker and Solo hid in a closet, while the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] stood watch, blending in with the Palace guards. Organa barreled through the walls of the palace with an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] blazing and picked up her companions. Organa's piloting allowed them to avoid the Royal guards giving chase through the [[Anem|city]] on [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]].

With the codes in hand, the Rebels returned to the [[South Anem Spaceport]], where they had hid their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], with a [[Nyemarian]], [[Li Preni]], who owed Solo a favor. The [[Gender/Legends|man]] lied about meeting the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] following the Rebels, but told the truth when Chewbacca threatened him. Thinking it was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] following them, Solo convinced the others to confront the [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphid]].

===Mysterious messenger===
{{Quote|I been looking for you for a long time. And it's worth a big reward for me if you just listen to this message.|The messenger to Skywalker|<ref name="Uprising" />}}
The Rebels cornered the Glymphid following them. The Glymphid approached Skywalker and gave him a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] from former Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] asking for Skywalker to meet him in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], and threatening to kill a [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|colony vessel]] full of over 100 passengers if Skywalker didn't comply. As a measure of his power, Soresh had the messenger killed in fromt of Skywalker using some sort of time-delayed [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. Skywalker knew he had no choice and would go alone to meet Soresh, but his companions would not let him go without backup. They then left Nyemari to [[Battle of the Sixela system|meet]] Soresh on his [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren moon]], instead of continuing to Organa's diplomatic trip to the [[Winagrew system/Legends|Winagrew system]], as was originally planned.

==Behind the scenes==
The mission appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.
